gamespot.com/articles/one-of-2026s-bigge.title: One Of 2026’s Biggest RPGs Is Hiding Inside Fanatical’s New $7 Mystery Bundle
gamespot.com/articles/one-of-2026s-bigge.excerpt: I don’t want to stake my excitement before the game’s launch, but The Blood of Dawnwalker is looking like it could be one of my favorite RPGs in recent years. As a sucker for bloodsuckers, Rebel Wolves’ debut project looks similar to The Witcher 3–which is high praise, of course–and it’s no surprise, considering the development team was founded by key developers from CD Projekt Red. With launch almost here, I’m keen to give it a try–but some lucky vampires could get the game’s premium edition for just $7, alongside some extra Steam games, too. Personally speaking, I don't think the best RPGs just give you a sprawling world and decent combat. They make every action and every quest–whether a main story mission or a side quest–feel important and, if possible, have greater effects on the overall world. The Blood of Dawnwalker seems to handle that well. Each day has eight segments, and completing tasks or handling important conversations takes up time. With only 30 days to save protagonist Coen’s family before a vampiric coronation, well, any simple side quest could demand your valuable time. Or, potentially, net you an ally that becomes essential. As the titular Dawnwalker, you gain access to vampiric abilities while still being able to walk around in the light of day–lucky you. Whether you decide to take a hefty chomp out of an enemy, earning you some health in return, or traverse with a sleek shadow step, there’s no shortage of nighttime abilities. During the day, you can use magic like hexes or rely on Coen’s mastery with a sword to survive daytime perils. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=huZyHs-ly44 The Blood of Dawnwalker looks like it captures the essence of urgency without making it feel frustrating or overwhelming. As someone who was disappointed with Bloodlines 2, I’m desperate for a great vampire RPG, and that’s exactly why I’m going to be a day-one player. rockpapershotgun.com/i-just-want-to-go-b.title: "I just want to go back inside": How Creative Assembly use weather to make you crave claustrophobic interiors in Alien Isolation 2
rockpapershotgun.com/i-just-want-to-go-b.excerpt: As I stand on the lee side of the wrecked haz lab, all I can hear is the rain pelt its metal roof and the feral wind howl about me. Planet LV-921 may have a breathable atmosphere, but it's not a safe planet. And that's before the xenomorph enters the scene and starts hunting the colonists living in Weyland-Yutani's Kurasaki mining station. Alien: Isolation 2, the long-awaited sequel to Creative Assembly's 2014 horror game, moves the action out from the original's claustrophobic Sevastopol Station, but the developers have worked out ways to make the wide open spaces of LV-921 feel just as tense and trapping. rockpapershotgun.com/the-internet-we-onc.excerpt: The owners of Nexus Mods have acquired community-run backend database SteamDB from its founders, the two sides in the deal have announced. The folks behind the former, who've held its keys for 13 years, said their decision to step back is rooted in burnout and a desire to find a suitable team to keep SteamDB running. Meanwhile, Nexus Mods' owners, a company called Chosen, have pointed to wanting to keep track of game updates from a modding perspective as one of the factors that's drawn them to make this deal. rockpapershotgun.com/in-dungeon-settlers.title: In Dungeon Settlers, you build a colony on top of a teeming RPG labyrinth in a trim take on Rimworld
rockpapershotgun.com/in-dungeon-settlers.excerpt: The first time I lost my whole party in Dungeon Settlers, it was to a swarm of rats. I think we can all agree that getting killed by rats in anything remotely fantasy RPG-ish is an enormous faux pas. It's like spelling your own name wrong on your CV. It's like accidentally wearing your underpants on top of your trousers. It's like failing to become Thane of Whiterun. In my defence, I was playing the game on Hard difficulty, and the rodents of Dungeon Settlers have a zoologically improbable habit of keeping company with stone golems. Ever tried to crack a stone golem with a wooden sword? I have found it inconvenient. In any case, while my party wipe was embarrassing, it was also excellently macabre in the fine traditions of Dwarf Fortress . Read more

gta6_screenshots.headline: Rockstar Unveils Grand Theft Auto 6 Trailer, Showcasing Massive Visual Leap Over Vice City
gta6_screenshots.summary: Rockstar Games released a 30‑minute gameplay trailer for Grand Theft Auto 6, highlighting dramatic graphical improvements compared to the 2002 Vice City release.
highlights: Grand Theft Auto 6 trailer reveals a sprawling, detailed world powered by the RAGE engine
Side‑by‑side screenshots expose stark fidelity differences from the PS2 version of Vice City
Modern consoles deliver crowded clubs and realistic police chases unseen in 2002
Development spanned nearly a decade, contrasting Vice City’s one‑year creation
The game launches in November on PS5 and Xbox

cod_cheat_cease.headline: Activision Publishes Body‑Cam Video of Cheat Maker Served Cease‑And‑Desist
cod_cheat_cease.summary: Activision released body‑cam footage showing a **Call of Duty** cheat developer being handed a cease‑and‑desist order as the company escalates its anti‑cheat campaign.
highlights: Activision’s **RICOCHET** anti‑cheat team filmed the enforcement action in Ohio.
The target, known as “Elocarry,” was served a legal cease‑and‑desist notice.
Activision says the operation is part of a broader push against cheat sellers worldwide.
Footage was shared during the **Call of Duty** Closed Beta on August 28, 2026.

projecthelix_family.headline: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma Teases Project Helix Family of Devices
projecthelix_family.summary: Xbox chief Asha Sharma hinted at a multi‑device lineup for Project Helix, suggesting a next‑gen console that could break the traditional box model.
highlights: Project Helix was announced in March with promised PC‑gaming capability
Sharma described a "great family of devices" during her gamescom 2026 interview
The upcoming hardware may follow the dual‑release strategy of Series X and Series S
Microsoft is considering new business models to avoid "thousands of dollars" price points

ps5_pro_stock.headline: PS5 Pro Consoles Vanish After GTA 6 Reveal, Prices Spike to $1,300
ps5_pro_stock.summary: Following the GTA 6 extended look, PS5 Pro stock has evaporated, forcing shoppers to pay up to $1,300 at limited retailers.
highlights: PS5 Pro units are out at major retailers except PlayStation Direct’s $899 offer
Third‑party sellers list the console for $1,299 on Amazon and Walmart
eBay listings show new PS5 Pros selling for as much as $1,200

gta6_protagonist_decision.headline: Rockstar Rejects Four‑Protagonist GTA 6 to Preserve Player Connection
gta6_protagonist_decision.summary: Rockstar decided against adding a fourth playable character in **Grand Theft Auto 6**, fearing it would dilute player time and weaken bonds with each protagonist.
highlights: Rockstar considered a four‑character roster before settling on two protagonists
Co‑head Rod Nelson told IGN the team worried about spreading player attention too thin
The final trailer on Netflix highlighted the chemistry between **Lucia** and **Jason**
The game’s world is three times larger than **Red Dead Redemption 2** and features an expanded honor system

rust_roadmap_overhaul.headline: Rust Roadmap Overhaul Shifts Battle Pass to Premium, Delays Major Features
rust_roadmap_overhaul.summary: Facepunch reshuffles the 2026 Rust roadmap, scrapping the Battle Pass for Rust Premium and pushing key updates to 2027 while advancing pet dogs.
highlights: Battle Pass removed and replaced by Rust Premium
Procedural caves, nexus system, and terrain deformation delayed to 2027
Pet dogs moved up to release in 2026
Animal husbandry, player customization, and biofuel generators slated before year‑end

project_helix_family_devices.headline: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma Announces Multi‑Device Strategy for Next‑Gen Project Helix
project_helix_family_devices.summary: Xbox plans to launch a family of next‑generation consoles under Project Helix, aiming for broader affordability and PC‑gaming integration.
highlights: Project Helix will encompass multiple console variants rather than a single model
Xbox Series X and Series S set precedent for a dual‑console approach
Sharma cites hardware shortages and cost efficiency as drivers for new designs
Microsoft aims to enable both console and PC game play on future devices

tw_w40k_definitive_goal.headline: Creative Assembly Unveils Total War: Warhammer 40,000 as Definitive 40K Strategy
tw_w40k_definitive_goal.summary: Creative Assembly’s new Total War: Warhammer 40,000 promises a definitive, cover‑focused grand strategy experience that blends tabletop lore with modern tactical depth.
highlights: The game introduces cover systems and sightlines reminiscent of Dawn of War RTS titles
Space Marine drop‑pods and Ork Stompas provide cinematic, large‑scale battles
A dedicated tutorial campaign aims to ease newcomers into the complex mechanics
First 18‑rated title from Creative Assembly, featuring authentic 40K units and lore

cod_mw4_anti_cheat.headline: Call of Duty Sends Cease‑And‑Desist Blitz Ahead of Modern Warfare 4 Launch
cod_mw4_anti_cheat.summary: Activision announced it has issued over 80 cease‑and‑desist letters and shut down 375 cheat operations to protect fair play in Modern Warfare 4.
highlights: Over 80 cease‑and‑desist letters served to cheat vendors
375 cheat reseller operations and 30 vendors disrupted
Ricochet anti‑cheat used in early‑access beta showed faster action times
Legal threats include potential court action and hardware bans

ea_ironman_leak_response.headline: EA Addresses Iron Man Gameplay Leak, Promises More Content Soon
ea_ironman_leak_response.summary: EA acknowledged the unexpected Iron Man footage leak, confirming the test build’s mishap while teasing further reveals for the upcoming title.
highlights: Leak originated from an “Aug26 test” build shared on ResetEra
Footage shows open‑world city flight and rapid on‑foot combat transitions
EA’s Marvel’s Iron Man has faced a quiet development since its 2022 announcement

ea_ironman_leak_followup.headline: EA Acknowledges Iron Man Leak, Promises More When Ready
ea_ironman_leak_followup.summary: EA confirmed a leaked Motive Studios gameplay clip featuring Iron Man, Pepper Potts, Obadiah Stane, and Madame Masque, but offered no release timeline.
highlights: Leak revealed Iron Man flying in multiple suits
Characters Pepper Potts, Obadiah Stane and Madame Masque appear
EA’s official X account responded with a brief statement
Project first teased in 2022, still under development

squadron42_delay.headline: Squadron 42 Delayed to 2027 as Cloud Imperium Cites GTA 6 Competition
squadron42_delay.summary: Cloud Imperium Games pushes its single‑player Star Citizen spin‑off Squadron 42 to Q2 2027, fearing the launch would be eclipsed by Rockstar’s GTA 6 hype.
highlights: Release moved from Q4 2026 to Q2 2027.
CEO Chris Roberts says GTA 6 will dominate media attention.
Squadron 42 features a star‑studded cast including Gary Oldman and Mark Hamill.
Cloud Imperium will preview the game to a limited group of creators in October.
New $5,000 Anvil Odin capital ship announced alongside the delay.

hello_neighbor_hack.headline: Secret Neighbor Temporarily Shut Down After Hacker Erases Player Progress
hello_neighbor_hack.summary: A hacker breached Secret Neighbor’s backend, wiping player progression and demanding the game’s removal, forcing Hologryph and tinyBuild to temporarily shut it down.
highlights: The attacker obtained admin credentials and deleted all player profiles and in‑game progress.
Developer Hologryph and publisher tinyBuild announced a coordinated server attack across all platforms.
No personal data was compromised, but the breach prompted a temporary offline period while vulnerabilities are patched.
The companies are working with backend provider PlayFab to recover the lost data.
TinyBuild had previously invested $3 million in Hologryph and holds a majority stake.

project_helix_family.headline: Xbox Unveils Project Helix Family, Leaves Elder Scrolls 6 Exclusivity Unclear
project_helix_family.summary: Microsoft’s Xbox CEO Asha Sharma hinted at a versatile next‑gen hardware line while refusing to confirm whether **The Elder Scrolls 6** will stay exclusive to Xbox.
highlights: Project Helix is described as a “family of devices” that may span multiple form factors
Sharma emphasized affordability and efficiency amid a global component shortage
The company reiterated its commitment to exclusive experiences like **Gears 5** and **Clockwork**
No definitive answer was given on **The Elder Scrolls 6** exclusivity
Rumors suggest a possible handheld device could join the Helix lineup

gta6_no_microtransactions.headline: Rockstar Confirms GTA 6 Launch Without Microtransactions or Generative AI
gta6_no_microtransactions.summary: Rockstar Games says the November 19, 2026 release of **GTA 6** will be free of microtransactions and generative AI, though an optional $99.99 Ultimate Edition will offer extra cosmetics.
highlights: No in‑game purchases using real money will be available at launch
Generative AI tools are not integrated into the game’s systems
The Ultimate Edition costs $99.99 and adds exclusive cars, guns, and cosmetic packs
Launch dates set for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S on November 19, 2026

project_helix_discless_status.headline: XBOX CEO Declines to Confirm If Project Helix Will Be Disc‑Less
project_helix_discless_status.summary: Asha Sharma avoided confirming whether the upcoming Project Helix will abandon physical discs, as Xbox rolls out a disc‑to‑digital option for Insiders amid rising hardware costs.
highlights: Xbox plans a disc‑to‑digital transition before PlayStation ends physical discs in 2028
Project Helix is described as a “family of devices” without a firm disc‑less commitment
RAM and memory price spikes have forced Xbox to raise legacy hardware prices
The next‑gen Xbox aims to run both console and PC games on the same platform

dlss5_ai_filter_leak_ps5.headline: Leaked DLSS 5 AI Filter Warps Major PS5 Games' Visuals
dlss5_ai_filter_leak_ps5.summary: A leaked version of Nvidia's DLSS 5 generative‑AI filter has been applied to several flagship PS5 titles, sparking criticism over altered artistic intent.
highlights: DLSS 5 files extracted from the PC version of **NBA 2K27** and repurposed for Sony’s catalog
Fans report distorted looks for characters like **Grace Ashcroft** in **Resident Evil Requiem** and **MJ** in **Marvel’s
The filter also produces exaggerated aging on **Ellie** and parody‑like changes to **Cloud** from **Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth**
Nvidia CEO **Jensen Huang** insists the technology does not compromise artistic control, labeling it “content‑control generative

valve_data_leak_2026.headline: 12 TB of Valve Steam Builds and Betas Leak, Exposing Early Versions of Major Titles
valve_data_leak_2026.summary: A massive 12‑13 TB leak of Valve’s internal builds from 2003‑2013, including early versions of **Portal 2**, **Left 4 Dead**, **CS:GO**, and other third‑party games, has surfaced online.
highlights: Early beta of **Portal 2** and **Left 4 Dead** discovered in the dump
Unreleased content from **F‑Stop**, **Half‑Life 2: Episode 3**, and **Batman: Arkham Asylum** appears
Third‑party titles such as **Sonic 4**, **Dragon Age: Origins**, and **Call of Duty 4** are also included
Leak originated from a publicly accessible Steam directory, not a hack

valve_data_leak_2026_duplicate.headline: Valve Data Leak Exposes Portal 2 Beta, Half‑Life 2 Episode 3 Weaponizer
valve_data_leak_2026_duplicate.summary: A 12‑terabyte leak of Valve’s internal builds reveals the elusive Portal 2 beta and a possible weapon from the cancelled Half‑Life 2: Episode 3.
highlights: Leak contains 12 TB of files dated 2003‑2013
Complete Portal 2 beta from 2009 appears in the archive
Weaponizer, an unfinished Half‑Life 2: Episode 3 weapon, is included
Files from cancelled puzzle project F‑STOP also surfaced

xbox_server_shutdowns_sep2026.headline: Three Xbox Live Services End in September 2026
xbox_server_shutdowns_sep2026.summary: Three Xbox games—**Hawked**, **GRID Legends**, and **Sociable Soccer 25**—will lose online functionality in September 2026, though offline modes remain playable.
highlights: Hawked goes offline on September 7, 2026
GRID Legends loses online features on September 11, 2026
Sociable Soccer 25 shuts down servers on September 28, 2026

gta6_release_date_confirmed.headline: Rockstar North Confirms **GTA 6** Still Set for November 19 Release
gta6_release_date_confirmed.summary: Rob Nelson of **Rockstar North** reassured fans that **GTA 6** will launch on November 19, despite previous delays and lingering skepticism.
highlights: Original launch slated for 2025, pushed to May 2026, now confirmed for November 19
Nelson emphasized stable performance and ongoing refinements
Team continues collaborative development across complex systems

valve_12tb_leak_steamterraleak.headline: Valve Steam Terraleak Exposes 12TB of Unreleased PC Builds Including Portal 2 and Half‑Life 2 Episode 3
valve_12tb_leak_steamterraleak.summary: A public leak of Valve’s old Steam pipeline has released 12 TB of internal builds, revealing never‑seen versions of Portal 2, Left 4 Dead and possible Half‑Life 2 Episode 3 content.
highlights: 12 TB of internal game assets from 2003‑2013 were made publicly downloadable
Unreleased builds include Portal 2, Left 4 Dead, Counter‑Strike: Global Offensive and the pre‑release F‑Stop project
Potential files related to the long‑rumored Half‑Life 2 Episode 3 surfaced in the archive
Third‑party titles such as Alan Wake, Sonic 4 and Fallout New Vegas also appear among the leaked data

valve_12tb_leak_eurogamer.headline: 12TB Valve Archive Leak Reveals Early *Portal 2* Builds and Possible *Half‑Life 2: Episode Three* Assets
valve_12tb_leak_eurogamer.summary: A massive 12‑terabyte leak of Valve's development files from 2003‑2013 includes early *Portal 2* versions, a playable *Left 4 Dead* beta, and hints of the cancelled *Half‑Life 2: Episode Three*.
highlights: Early *Portal 2* beta and a "Weaponizer" model surfaced in the archive
Fully playable *Left 4 Dead* beta from June 2008 was identified
Assets from the cancelled prequel *F‑Stop* and potential *Episode Three* material were found

valve_12tb_leak_kotaku.headline: 13TB Steam Leak Exposes Beta Builds of Portal 2, Left 4 Dead 2 and More
valve_12tb_leak_kotaku.summary: A massive 13‑terabyte leak of Valve’s Steam depot data from 2003‑2013 has surfaced, revealing early versions of dozens of PC titles.
highlights: Leak contains beta builds of Portal 2, Left 4 Dead 2, Dragon Age: Origins, and Batman: Arkham Asylum
Data spans a decade of Valve’s releases, ending around the launch of SteamOS 1.0 in 2013
Community is cataloguing files on GitHub while ex‑Valve developer Elan Ruskin confirms the authenticity of the builds

activision_cheatseller_ceaseanddesist_fo.headline: Activision Serves Cease‑And‑Desist to Ohio Cheat Seller, Posts Footage
activision_cheatseller_ceaseanddesist_fo.summary: Activision filmed its legal rep delivering a cease‑and‑desist order to an Ohio cheat vendor linked to Call of Duty and other multiplayer titles.
highlights: Activision posted a one‑minute video of the delivery on the official Call of Duty account
The target, known as Elocarry, sold cheats for Call of Duty, Rust, and Apex Legends
Cheat packs were priced up to £79.99 and claimed to evade RICOCHET detection
Activision reports over 80 cease‑and‑desist notices served and 30 vendors shut down

activision_cheatseller_ceaseanddesist_pc.headline: Activision Serves Cease‑And‑Desist to Infamous Call of Duty Cheat Maker on Camera
activision_cheatseller_ceaseanddesist_pc.summary: Activision filmed a legal representative delivering a cease‑and‑desist to cheat creator Elocarry, signaling a public crackdown on cheating in Call of Duty.
highlights: Activision posted video of the delivery on the official Call of Duty X account
Elocarry paused sales of Call of Duty cheats after receiving the order
Activision claims 80 cease‑and‑desist letters disrupted 375 reseller operations and shut down 30 vendors
Beta data for Modern Warfare 4 shows lower infection rates and harder‑to‑evade hardware bans

playstation_digitalownership_courtcase.headline: Sony Faces Class Action Over Digital Game Ownership Claims
playstation_digitalownership_courtcase.summary: Sony must prove that PlayStation users understand they only license, not own, digital games amid a class‑action lawsuit filed on June 18.
highlights: Four consumers filed a class‑action complaint alleging misleading ownership language
Sony argues the End User License Agreement clearly states games are licensed
California law requires clear disclosure when terms like “buy” suggest ownership
Sony announced it will cease physical game production by 2028

steam_data_leak_12tb.headline: 12TB Steam Data Leak Exposes Decade of Game Files
steam_data_leak_12tb.summary: A massive 12TB leak from Steam has revealed complete and prototype game files from 2003‑2013, including unreleased versions of titles like Left 4 Dead.
highlights: Leak sourced from a publicly accessible endpoint, no hacking required
Data covers every Steam title released between 2003 and 2013, not just Valve games
Includes full games, beta builds, and early prototypes such as a pre‑release Left 4 Dead version
Valve migrated storage in 2013, leaving older archives vulnerable
Archivists expect more undiscovered content as they sift through the 12TB

pokemon_unite_new_pokemon.headline: Pokémon Unite Adds Four New Playable Pokémon Ahead of World Championships Finale
pokemon_unite_new_pokemon.summary: Four fresh Pokémon—Morpeko, Toxtricity, Jolteon, and Flareon—join Pokémon Unite this September‑October, expanding the roster before the final championship event.
highlights: Morpeko arrives on 4 September 2026
Toxtricity follows on 24 September 2026
Jolteon and Flareon debut in October 2026, completing the Eevee line
The 2026 Pokémon World Championships host the final Unite finals
Next year’s tournament shifts to Pokémon UNITE Aeos Crown 2027 in Tokyo

pokemon_champions_z_megas.headline: Pokémon Champions Update Introduces Z Mega Evolutions on September 9
pokemon_champions_z_megas.summary: The free‑to‑play Pokémon Champions will add Z Mega Evolutions, including Mega Lucario Z, Mega Absol Z, and Mega Heatran, launching on 9 September 2026.
highlights: New Z Mega Evolutions debut in Pokémon Champions
Featured Pokémon: Mega Lucario Z, Mega Absol Z, Mega Heatran, Rillaboom, Baxcalibur
Release date set for 9 September 2026 (JST)
Free in‑game rewards include a themed hat, t‑shirt, and Incineroar via Twitch

pokemon_wild_card_movie.headline: Pokémon: Wild Card Movie Announced for 2027, Featuring TCG Protagonist
pokemon_wild_card_movie.summary: The Pokémon Company revealed a new animated film, Pokémon: Wild Card, set for a 2027 release and centered on a Pokémon TCG player’s championship quest.
highlights: The film was unveiled at the 2026 Pokémon World Championships closing ceremony
A 39‑second teaser showcases the Pokémon Trading Card Game and Mimikyu
Animation will be handled by CloverWorks under director Katsuhiko Kitada
Producer Story inc. and character designer Akemi Hayashi join the project
Release is slated for 2027 with potential extensions beyond the debut

pokemon_champions_z_megaevolutions.headline: Pokémon Champions Introduces Z Mega Evolutions for Lucario, Absol, Garchomp
pokemon_champions_z_megaevolutions.summary: The Pokémon Company unveiled a trailer revealing Z Mega Evolutions for Lucario, Absol and Garchomp debuting in Regulation Set M‑C on September 9.
highlights: Z Mega Evolutions arrive with unique abilities: Sharpness, Wave Shield, and Levitate.
Mega Absol Z gains a cutting‑move boost, Mega Lucario Z gains damage reduction, Mega Garchomp Z gains Ground immunity.
New Pokémon Rillaboom and Baxcalibur also join the upcoming set.
Trailer hints at Mega Heatran, likely slated for Regulation Set M‑D in December.

stranded_deep_2_early_access.headline: Stranded Deep 2 Reveals Trailer and Screenshots, Early Access Announced
stranded_deep_2_early_access.summary: North Beach Games unveiled the first look at Stranded Deep 2, a desert survival sequel slated for Early Access on PC via Steam, featuring a dynamic river world.
highlights: Explore an endless river world with canyons, dunes, and rapids
Build a floating home that can be moved across the desert
Survival mechanics track health, hunger, thirst, and exposure
Cartographer editor lets players create and share custom locations

battle_of_olympus_steam_remake.headline: Original NES Platformer *The Battle of Olympus* Gets Handcrafted Steam Remake
battle_of_olympus_steam_remake.summary: The 1988 side‑scrolling classic *The Battle of Olympus* will return to PC in early 2027 as a lovingly rebuilt Steam remake by its original creators.
highlights: Developers Yukio Horimoto and Reiko Horimoto will personally recode and redraw the game
The remake targets early access launch on Steam in January 2027
It preserves the original’s Greek‑myth theme and challenging platforming while updating graphics for modern PCs
The project is billed as the duo’s final major game product before retirement

stellar_blade_switch2_release.headline: Stellar Blade: Complete Edition Lands on Switch 2 with Full Gameplay Reveal
stellar_blade_switch2_release.summary: Shift Up showcases over five minutes of gameplay and explains how the 2024 PlayStation hit was optimized for Switch 2’s HD Rumble and touchscreen features.
highlights: Stellar Blade first launched on PlayStation in 2024 and on PC in 2025
The Complete Edition bundles two DLCs, new outfits, and seasonal events
Developers ported PlayStation 5 haptic data directly to Switch 2’s HD Rumble
Switch 2 version adds touchscreen, gyro, and optional mouse controls

stellar_blade_lies_of_p_korea.headline: Stellar Blade and Lies of P Spark Korean Console Game Renaissance
stellar_blade_lies_of_p_korea.summary: Stellar Blade’s multi‑million sales and Lies of P’s acclaim have motivated Korean studios to pursue ambitious console titles, reshaping the local industry.
highlights: Stellar Blade sold millions and is set for a Switch 2 port at TGS 2026
Lies of P is hailed as the top non‑FromSoftware Soulslike
Shift Up’s technical director credits these titles for inspiring Korean console development
Upcoming AAA project Project Spirits reflects the new ambition

gta6_leaker_investigation.headline: Take‑Two’s GTA 6 Leak Probe Accelerates with New Confidential Discord Subpoena
gta6_leaker_investigation.summary: Take‑Two is intensifying its legal hunt for the GTA 6 leaker, filing a sealed subpoena targeting specific Discord users after earlier public requests were withdrawn.
highlights: Take‑Two filed a second, sealed subpoena to Discord focusing on one identified user and another suspect
Earlier subpoenas to Microsoft, Discord, X and YouTube were partially served or withdrawn
The leak, posted by the group ‘Cyberleek’, amassed millions of views before the official Netflix reveal

digital_game_ownership_lawsuit.headline: Sony Defends Digital Licenses Amid California Ownership Disclosure Lawsuit
digital_game_ownership_lawsuit.summary: Sony argues PlayStation users understand that digital purchases are licenses, not ownership, as a California law‑mandated disclosure case challenges its labeling practices.
highlights: Sony faces a proposed class action alleging inadequate disclosure of digital game licensing
The lawsuit cites the $69.99 purchase of Resident Evil Requiem on the PlayStation Store
Court is deciding whether the case proceeds to arbitration or settlement
Potential outcome could force a label change from “Buy” to “Purchase a digital license”
Sony announced it will cease new game disc production with the upcoming PS6 generation

gta6_screenshots_novlaunch.headline: Rockstar Unveils New GTA 6 Screenshots Ahead of November 19 Launch
gta6_screenshots_novlaunch.summary: Rockstar released fresh screenshots showcasing character customization, a Miami‑inspired Vice City condo, and tense story moments as the November 19 release nears.
highlights: Over 99 screenshots revealed, with three never‑seen‑before images
Shows Jason and Lucia’s new tattoos, piercings, and hairstyles
Features a detailed recreation of Miami’s Two Tequesta Point in Vice City
Confirms launch for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on November 19, 2026

gta6_leak_subpoena.headline: Take‑Two Seeks Sealed Subpoena to Shield GTA 6 Leak Probe from Leakers
gta6_leak_subpoena.summary: Take‑Two has filed a sealed subpoena targeting Discord users to prevent further leaks of the highly anticipated GTA 6, citing confidentiality concerns.
highlights: Take‑Two filed a new sealed subpoena focusing on specific Discord users
The request aims to keep investigation details from tipping off leakers
Previous wide‑net DMCA subpoenas to Microsoft and Discord remain public
Take‑Two claims disclosure could compromise the ongoing copyright infringement probe

steam_leak_13tb.headline: Massive Steam Leak Exposes Prototype Builds of Valve Classics
steam_leak_13tb.summary: A 13‑terabyte Steam depot leak reveals unfinished versions of Portal 2, Counter‑Strike: Global Offensive, Left 4 Dead 2, and other Valve titles.
highlights: Prototype builds of Portal 2 from 2009 and 2010 include scrapped Adhesive Gel and Paint Gun mechanics
Early Counter‑Strike: Global Offensive builds show PS3 and Xbox 360 ports and hidden family‑guy ragdoll physics
Prototype Left 4 Dead 2 versions contain buggy maps, higher jumps, and placeholder audio
F‑Stop assets appear within the Portal 2 leak, hinting at a cancelled prequel project

starwarszero_furlough.headline: Bit Reactor Furloughs Up to 80% Staff After Star Wars Zero Company Steam Success
starwarszero_furlough.summary: Bit Reactor has placed up to 80% of its workforce on unpaid furloughs despite Star Wars Zero Company topping Steam sales and launching on multiple consoles.
highlights: Furloughs affect up to 80% of Bit Reactor staff
Studio cites launch‑performance uncertainty, not EA or Disney pressure
Star Wars Zero Company remains the top‑selling game on Steam
Game released simultaneously on PS5 and Xbox consoles

capcom_tgs2026_lineup.headline: Capcom Unveils TGS 2026 Lineup Featuring Dragon’s Dogma II and Monster Hunter Expansion
capcom_tgs2026_lineup.summary: Capcom announced its Tokyo Game Show 2026 showcase, revealing new titles and updates across PlayStation, Xbox, Switch, and PC platforms.
highlights: Dragon’s Dogma II: Dark Arisen confirmed for PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2, and PC
Mega Man: Dual Override will launch on all current-gen consoles and PC
Monster Hunter Wilds Expansion “Ascendance” arrives on PS5, Xbox Series, and PC
Onimusha: Way of the Sword slated for next‑gen consoles and PC
Capcom Spotlight livestream scheduled for September 16 at 7 a.m. PT

disc_to_digital_delisted_support.headline: Xbox Disc-to-Digital Program Lets Insiders Digitize Delisted Games
disc_to_digital_delisted_support.summary: Xbox Insiders can now convert physical discs of delisted titles into digital licenses, enabling play on Series S and PC via Play Anywhere.
highlights: Early access granted to Insider program as of Aug 31
Physical discs of removed titles receive digital licenses
Games become playable on Series S and PC if Play Anywhere‑compatible
Publishers must approve digital licensing for each title

disc_to_digital_preservation.headline: Xbox Disc‑to‑Digital Feature Rescues Delisted Titles Like Deadpool and Rock Band 4
disc_to_digital_preservation.summary: Players are leveraging Xbox’s disc‑to‑digital conversion to retain access to long‑delisted games such as Deadpool, Rock Band 4, and Transformers: Devastation.
highlights: Xbox’s disc‑to‑digital service now grants digital licenses for physical copies of delisted games
First known case is the Deadpool game receiving a permanent digital entitlement
Fans have also saved Rock Band 4 and Transformers: Devastation using the same method
The feature highlights Xbox’s commitment to preserving player libraries despite publisher pull‑outs

digital_ownership_lawsuit.headline: Sony argues “reasonable consumers” know digital games are licences, not owned copies
digital_ownership_lawsuit.summary: Sony told a California court that buyers of digital titles on the PlayStation Store already understand they purchase a licence, not ownership, amid a lawsuit over misleading terminology.
highlights: Sony filed a response claiming consumers are aware digital purchases are licences
Four players sued Sony for allegedly violating California law with “Buy Now” language
Sony reminded users via email that the Terms of Service define digital purchases as personal licences
The case arises as Sony plans to end physical disc releases by January 2028

witcher4_physical_box.headline: CD Projekt Guarantees Boxed Edition of The Witcher 4 for PlayStation Even Without a Disc
witcher4_physical_box.summary: CD Projekt pledged a collectible box for the upcoming The Witcher 4 on PlayStation, despite Sony’s 2028 shift to fully digital releases.
highlights: CD Projekt will release a physical box for The Witcher 4 on PlayStation
Sony plans all PlayStation games to be digital‑only starting in 2028
Joint‑CEO Michał Nowakowski says the studio has no control over disc policies
The boxed edition will include “feelies” and other tangible collectibles

brutal_legend2_kickstarter.headline: Double Fine Leaves Xbox, Launches Kickstarter Aiming for $100 Million Brütal Legend 2
brutal_legend2_kickstarter.summary: Double Fine has cut ties with Xbox and opened a Kickstarter to fund its Amnesia Fortnight 2026 jam, promising a Brütal Legend 2 sequel if a $100 million goal is somehow reached.
highlights: Double Fine’s Kickstarter seeks $400,000, currently at $275,000
The campaign promises a Brütal Legend 2 sequel at a $100 million stretch goal
Over 25 prototype pitches are available for backers to vote on
The studio previously raised funds for Broken Age via Kickstarter
Double Fine’s recent titles include Kiln and Keeper

zero_company_furlough.headline: Bit Reactor Furloughs 80% of Staff Just Before Star Wars Zero Company Launch
zero_company_furlough.summary: The studio behind the bestselling PC title Star Wars Zero Company placed roughly 80% of its workforce on unpaid furlough days before the game's release.
highlights: Bit Reactor confirmed about 80% of staff are now on furlough without pay.
CEO Greg Foertsch promoted the game at Gamescom while the layoffs were concealed.
Former COO Alison Kelly alleges she was forced out and is suing, with trial set for early 2027.
The game’s success on Steam may determine whether the studio can reinstate its team.

gamepass_removals_sept2026.headline: Cyberpunk 2077 and Nine Other Titles Exit Xbox Game Pass on September 15
gamepass_removals_sept2026.summary: Ten popular games, including Cyberpunk 2077, will be removed from the Xbox Game Pass library on September 15, with discounted purchase options offered.
highlights: Cyberpunk 2077 leaves the service on September 15
Dead Cells, Frostpunk 2, and Deep Rock Galactic Survivor also depart

New titles like RuneScape: Dragonwilds and Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War added

gamepass_sept_wave1.headline: Xbox Game Pass September 2026 Wave 1 Adds Seven New Titles
gamepass_sept_wave1.summary: Xbox Game Pass announces its first September 2026 wave, introducing seven fresh titles including Call of Duty, Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O., and RuneScape: Dragonwilds.
highlights: Shelldiver launches on September 1 across cloud, console, and PC
Speedrunners 2: King of Speed arrives September 3 for Xbox Series X|S and PC
Dice a Million joins Game Pass Premium on September 4
Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War becomes available September 8
Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage debuts September 10

mw4_mobility_course.headline: Infinity Ward’s Mobility Course Turns Dev Competition Into Player Challenge
mw4_mobility_course.summary: Infinity Ward recorded frame‑by‑frame runs on Modern Warfare 4’s new mobility course, only to have players quickly surpass the developers’ times.
highlights: Developers used screen recordings to shave milliseconds from their runs
The mobility course was added to the game for player testing
Players discovered micro‑optimizations like jumping while reloading
Feedback revealed unexpected ways players interact with the new movement system

valorant_patch13_05.headline: VALORANT Patch 13.05 Cracks Down on Stream Snipers and Installs New Esports Rewards
valorant_patch13_05.summary: Riot Games’ VALORANT 13.05 update penalizes stream snipers and instalock tools while introducing Pick’Ems for the $2.25 million Champions Shanghai tournament.
highlights: Temporary bans for detected stream sniping and instalock tool usage, escalating to permanent bans on repeat offenses
Pick’Ems for Champions Shanghai launch on September 24 with $2.25 million prize pool
Sound Sprays now attenuated to limit audible range for clearer team communication

witcher3_remaster_ps5pro.headline: The Witcher 3 Remastered Gains 60fps Ray Tracing and Up to 90fps on PS5 Pro
witcher3_remaster_ps5pro.summary: CD Projekt Red’s Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered now leverages PS5 Pro hardware to double ray‑traced frame rates to 60fps and push performance mode toward 90fps.
highlights: Ray Tracing mode jumps from 30fps to 60fps on PS5 Pro
Performance mode can reach roughly 90fps with VRR support
The remaster uses the Pro’s PSSR upscaler for clearer visuals

onimusha_way_of_the_sword_release.headline: Capcom Announces Global Release Time for Onimusha: Way of the Sword
onimusha_way_of_the_sword_release.summary: Onimusha: Way of the Sword launches worldwide at midnight EDT on September 4, with detailed time‑zone conversions and tiered pre‑order bonuses for fans.
highlights: Release hits 12 a.m. EDT (Sept 4) globally, with local times listed for major regions
Standard, Deluxe and Premium Deluxe editions each include unique charm and weapon skins
Capcom offers exclusive outfits and haori sets for Deluxe and Premium buyers
Miyamoto Musashi returns as the protagonist in the revived samurai action series

gta5_major_update.headline: Rockstar Rolls Out nopixel V Roleplay Update for GTA 5 Ahead of GTA 6 Reveal
gta5_major_update.summary: Rockstar announced a major GTA 5 update called nopixel V, adding role‑play features, new areas, and a reworked customization system for PC players.
highlights: nopixel V transforms GTA 5 into a multiplayer role‑play experience
New locations include a Grand Hotel‑Casino and revamped Cypress Flats
Character customization and NPC behavior receive visual and AI upgrades
Closed beta starts on Sept 8 via the Rockstar Games Launcher
Future plans mention a PC game overlay and expanded events

gta6_netflix_view.headline: GTA 6 Gameplay Showcase Tops Netflix Movie Chart, Drawing 31.1 Million Viewers
gta6_netflix_view.summary: Rockstar’s 27‑minute GTA 6 showcase premiered on Netflix, hitting No. 1 on the English film list in 87 countries and amassing over 31.1 million views in days.
highlights: The extended look streamed on Netflix reached No. 1 in 87 of 93 tracked countries
Over 31.1 million people watched the showcase within a few days
The video has already earned 17 million views on YouTube
The map is said to be three times the size of Red Dead Redemption 2’s
The trailer revealed realistic details like dynamic clothing, hair strands, and environmental destruction

xbox_new_games_launch.headline: Nine New Xbox Games Launch Today Including Moonlighter 2 on Game Pass
xbox_new_games_launch.summary: Nine fresh titles arrive on Xbox on September 2, highlighted by Moonlighter 2’s debut on Xbox Series X|S and Game Pass.
highlights: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault debuts on Xbox Series X|S
Day‑one addition to September’s Xbox Game Pass lineup
Nine new Xbox titles released simultaneously
Action‑RPG roguelike blends merchant management with combat

mario_kart_8_deluxe_v4_0_0.headline: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe 4.0.0 Update Brings Switch 2 Visuals and Larger Multiplayer
mario_kart_8_deluxe_v4_0_0.summary: Nintendo’s version 4.0.0 patch for Mario Kart 8 Deluxe adds high‑resolution support, faster load times, and expands multiplayer to up to eight racers.
highlights: Added support for Nintendo Switch 2 displays and high‑resolution TVs for clearer visuals.
Loading times before races and battles have been shortened.
Multiplayer capacity increased to support five‑to‑eight players, with up to seven controllers connected.
CameraPlay feature introduced, allowing players to stream video via a USB camera in multiplayer and online modes.
Player speed boosted equivalent to one coin and Boo invisibility no longer slows racers.

mario_kart_8_deluxe_switch2_update.headline: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe Receives Major Switch 2 Update With Eight‑Player Split‑Screen
mario_kart_8_deluxe_switch2_update.summary: Nintendo’s latest patch adds clearer visuals, faster loading and expanded split‑screen support for up to eight racers on the Switch 2.
highlights: Supports up to eight players on a single screen on Switch 2
Adds CameraPlay feature for live video during races
Boosts player speed equivalent to one extra coin
Introduces a 96‑race endurance challenge for Booster Course Pass holders

mario_kart_8_eight_player_split.headline: Nintendo Adds Eight‑Player Splitscreen to Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
mario_kart_8_eight_player_split.summary: Nintendo’s free update for Mario Kart 8 Deluxe on Switch 2 introduces eight‑player splitscreen, portrait windows, CameraPlay faces, and faster load times.
highlights: Eight‑player splitscreen replaces the classic four‑player mode
Portrait‑style windows display all racers simultaneously
CameraPlay overlays friends’ faces during races
Visuals are enhanced and load times shortened

mario_kart_8_splitscreen_update.headline: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe Free Switch 2 Update Adds 8‑Player Split‑Screen Mode
mario_kart_8_splitscreen_update.summary: Nintendo’s Version 4.0.0 update for Mario Kart 8 Deluxe on Switch 2 introduces local 5‑8 player split‑screen, CameraPlay support, and faster loading times.
highlights: Local split‑screen now supports up to eight racers on a single Switch 2 display
CameraPlay lets players show their faces via compatible USB cameras in 2‑4 player and online sessions
Resolution is boosted and race loading times are reduced on Switch 2
Original Switch users receive a speed boost equivalent to one extra coin per race

steamdb_sale.headline: Nexus Mods Acquires SteamDB, Consolidating PC Modding Data
steamdb_sale.summary: Nexus Mods has bought SteamDB, promising to keep its brand while leveraging its extensive game manifest and player‑count data for the PC modding community.
highlights: Nexus Mods purchases SteamDB for an undisclosed sum
Former sole owner xPaw cites AI‑driven burnout as reason for sale
Victor “Foledinho” Folmann says SteamDB’s historic manifests will aid mod reliability
SteamDB will continue operating under Nexus Mods’ umbrella
xPaw will assist during transition to ensure smooth handover

xbox_major_outage_2026_09_02.headline: Xbox Reports Major Outage Affecting Sign‑In Across Consoles and PC
xbox_major_outage_2026_09_02.summary: Microsoft confirmed a widespread sign‑in failure on Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One, Xbox 360, Windows, Android and iPhone, halting game access.
highlights: Sign‑in services unavailable on Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One, Xbox 360, and Xbox on Windows
Mobile apps for Android and iPhone also unable to authenticate
Players cannot access games, apps, or social features until resolved

ps5_antitrust_settlement.headline: Sony Faces $7.85 Million Settlement Over PlayStation Store Monopoly
ps5_antitrust_settlement.summary: A class‑action suit may award $7.85 million to US PS5 users who bought digital games from the PlayStation Store between April 2019 and December 2023.
highlights: Preliminary payout of $7.85 million approved pending October 15 hearing
Digital purchases forced through PlayStation Store after alternative voucher options were removed
Sony announced it will cease physical disc production starting 2028
Eligible US customers must have bought games between 1 April 2019 and 31 December 2023

monster_hunter_wilds_ascendance.headline: Capcom Announces Massive Ascendance Expansion for Monster Hunter Wilds
monster_hunter_wilds_ascendance.summary: The upcoming Ascendance DLC adds the Eastlands region, new elder dragons, and the game‑changing Boost Bracer mechanic for all 14 weapons.
highlights: Eastlands region introduces fresh environments and tougher monsters
Boost Bracer lets players build energy for a powered‑up combat mode
All 14 weapon types receive unique Boost abilities
Elder dragons join the roster, raising the challenge level

monster_hunter_wilds_ascendance_trailer.headline: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance Adds Boost Bracer for Master Rank Hunts
monster_hunter_wilds_ascendance_trailer.summary: The new Boost Bracer mechanic expands all 14 weapon types, letting players build energy and unleash enhanced attacks in upcoming Master Rank content.
highlights: Boost Bracer introduces a charge‑up system for aggressive play
Each weapon gains unique Boost Driver actions
New combos and stronger attacks target Master Rank monsters
Launch slated for 2027 across PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC

starcraft_license_nexon.headline: Nexon Seeks License to Develop New StarCraft Title Amid Blizzard Spin‑Off Plans
starcraft_license_nexon.summary: Nexon is reportedly close to securing a license to create a new StarCraft game while Blizzard works on an open‑world shooter spin‑off.
highlights: Nexon aims to capitalize on StarCraft's enduring popularity in Korean internet cafés
A senior official says a licensing contract with Blizzard is near finalization
Junghun Lee highlighted genAI use in game production, raising potential controversy
Blizzard’s own StarCraft spin‑off, an open‑world shooter, may be previewed at BlizzCon 2026

acecombat8_livemodes.headline: Bandai Namco Unveils Ace Combat Online Live Service Modes
acecombat8_livemodes.summary: Ace Combat 8 adds a companion live‑service suite featuring cooperative PvE, mixed PvPvE battles, limited‑time events, and a social hub for pilots.
highlights: Co‑Op Assault pits two teams of four against AI targets for high scores
Co‑Op Warfare blends PvPvE with allied ground, air and sea units
Emergency missions offer limited‑time Scramble and Emergency Sortie challenges

nexusmods_acquires_steamdb.headline: Nexus Mods Acquires SteamDB to Boost PC Modding Data
nexusmods_acquires_steamdb.summary: Nexus Mods is buying SteamDB to combine analytics with modding tools, aiming for better game‑version tracking and long‑term stability.
highlights: Nexus Mods will integrate SteamDB’s live player counts and build data
Founder xPaw assures SteamDB will retain its independent ethos
Victor Folmann sees the merger improving mod compatibility with game updates
The acquisition adds a decade‑long catalog of Steam game metadata

mariokart8_splitscreen_update.headline: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe Gains Eight‑Player Split‑Screen in Surprise Switch 2 Update

Support for GameShare and CameraPlay with two‑to‑four players
